minimum_evidence_policy.rationale: Controlled fusion is multimodal screening support; one weak modality must not appear equivalent to a multimodal assessment.

staleness_rationale.profile: Profile factors change slowly and can remain useful for longer screening context.
staleness_rationale.dass21: Questionnaire results are treated as recent screening context for a defined short-term period.
staleness_rationale.mood: Daily check-in signals are short-lived and must be recent.
staleness_rationale.text: Submitted text analysis is contextual and should be recent.
staleness_rationale.speech: Future policy only; modality is unavailable in Phase 4E.
staleness_rationale.face: Future policy only; modality is unavailable in Phase 4E.
